title: Ek Daur Salami
body:
ek daur salami dunya ka sadiyon may aisa aata hai
jab koi payambar uth'ta hai ya koi shahadat paata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ay nehrGee furaat afsos kar apni kismat par
kausar ka saaqi aaj tere saahil se pyasa jaata hai
ek daur salami...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad aseer e jaur huwe afsos kisi ne ye na kaha
ye paon sutoon e kaaba hai zanjeer kise pehnata hai
ek daur salami...
<<DIVIDER>>
seemaab nazar aati hai mujhe har cheez udaas aur aazurdaar
fitrat gham ki hojati hai jab maahe moharram aata hai
ek daur salami...
